title: [Bug]: SimplePropertyGraphStore can't persist utf-8 encoded chars on Windows
author: ManuelR-D

comments.author: dosubot[bot]
comments.body:
<!-- Greeting -->
Hi @ManuelR-D! I'm [Dosu](https://go.dosu.dev/dosubot) and I’m helping the llama_index team.

<!-- Answer -->
This is a known bug that has been reported multiple times ([#17846](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/issues/17846) for Japanese, [#19564](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/issues/19564) for Chinese/GBK). Your diagnosis is correct—the [persist()](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/graph_stores/simple_labelled.py#L164-L171) and [from_persist_path()](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/graph_stores/simple_labelled.py#L173-L186) methods don't specify `encoding="utf-8"`, so Windows uses its locale default (cp1252, GBK, etc.).

Your monkey patch is the right fix. The same issue exists in several other core stores ([SimpleKVStore](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/storage/kvstore/simple_kvstore.py#L44-L45), [SimpleGraphStore](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/graph_stores/simple.py#L149-L150), [SimpleVectorStore](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/vector_stores/simple.py#L401-L402), [SimpleChatStore](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/ddeb22219e1255829d07cde44e172c8f8c6bd2ff/llama-index-core/llama_index/core/storage/chat_store/simple_chat_store.py#L93-L94)), so this appears to be a systemic issue in the persistence layer. A PR adding explicit UTF-8 encoding to these methods would be welcome.
